caption: The drawing depicts a garment, likely a vestment, with a pale beige base color. The garment is rectangular with rounded edges and an opening at the top for the head. There are two wide, brown borders forming a Y-shape from the shoulders to the waist, and then extending in a rectangular frame down the front of the vestment. The center panel inside the rectangular border is cream-colored and features an embroidered floral pattern; the embroidery includes green leaves and stems, pink flowers, and hints of red and purple. The background of the drawing is plain off-white, and there are no additional objects or designs present. The bottom right corner includes handwritten text, possibly the artist's name.
title: Ecclesiastical Vestment
